inventive_nucleus: A micro-machined, low-perfusion-optimized optical sensor is embedded within the existing PPG sensor's substrate to augment its performance under low perfusion conditions.
structure: The proposed device consists of a PPG sensor substrate with an embedded micro-machined sensor, a control unit, and a power source.
control_logic: Step 1: Embed the micro-machined sensor within the PPG sensor substrate.
Step 2: Integrate the control unit to process the sensor data.
interaction: The micro-machined sensor interacts with the PPG sensor substrate to augment its performance under low perfusion conditions.
operating_condition: The device operates under normal physiological conditions, with a perfusion index (PI) above 0.5.
failure_containment: The device contains the failure by physically integrating the low-perfusion-optimized sensor, reducing the impact of the existing PPG sensor's limitations.
expected_effect: The device is expected to improve the SpO2 accuracy under low perfusion conditions.
causal_chain: Failure: SpO2 sensor drift at low perfusion
Cause: Reduced signal quality under low perfusion conditions
Mechanism: Augmenting the PPG sensor's performance
